feeds.title: Andrew Van Beek Blog
feeds.description: Andrew Van Beek started wedding photography in 2002. He runs a commercial studio in the heart of Ottawa. He covers wedding photography, portrait photography, maternity photography, family photography, and boudoir photography.

feeds.title: Grey Loft Studio Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Grey Loft Studio Blog, where they share recent weddings & sessions, our tips, and bits of our life. They adore working with joyful couples in love, and can't wait to tell your story. Go through their blog and learn more about their photography work.

feeds.title: Danielle Aisling Blog
feeds.description: Danielle Aisling is a photographer specializing in elopements and intimate weddings. She wants to create something with you that you can keep forever. Her Blog posts are visuals of her work where she has portrayed beautiful couples in a very beautiful manner.

feeds.title: Union Eleven Photographers Blog
feeds.description: A collection of Ottawa wedding photos and videos showcasing the candid, natural style the Union Eleven is known for. Our focus capturing priceless moments between the people you love most.

feeds.title: Chelsea Gurr Photography Blog
feeds.description: Chelsea is an intimate wedding photographer. The images she creates encapsulate her clients' moments as naturally as they occur. They're honest moments, the ones we never want to forget. On her website, you can find lovely articles consisting of amazing stories about couples and their wedding days, as well as some tips to plan your wedding.

feeds.title: Carley Teresa Photography Blog
feeds.description: When it comes to photographing weddings, Carley Teresa see it as her job to document your day. The moments, the feeling, the emotions. She there to capture it all so anytime you look back at your photos, you'll remember the feeling.

feeds.title: Brittany Navin Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi there and welcome! I'm Brittany, a wedding & branding photographer. I absolutely adore photographing joyful couples that are in love! I hope you grab your drink of choice, cozy up on the couch, and enjoy browsing through my latest work in the blogs and learning from my latest tips, and getting a little peek into my personal life.

feeds.title: Ghattas Weddings Blog
feeds.description: Here at Ghattas, their goal is to capture as many authentic and candid shots as possible. They strive to make sure you are feeling comfortable and having fun at all times. To achieve this we hardly ever ask you to pose, and if we do it will be super simple and fun.

feeds.title: Ottawa Wedding Magazine
feeds.description: Ottawa Wedding Magazine is the must-have guide for the city's brides to be, it provides all the information and options you need to make your dream of a wedding day come true. From news about the latest drop-dead gorgeous, fairytale dresses to advice about planning, shopping, and making innumerable arrangements, Ottawa Wedding provides the know-how you need to create a beautiful, picture-perfect occasion that people will talk about for years to come.

feeds.title: Palm Tree Studio
feeds.description: The Palm Tree Studio was founded by a mutual passion for storytelling and celebrating the beauty of love! Our inspiration and creativity come solely from the love stories of our couples, which means that each of our portrayals is unique and timeless. The Wedding photography and videography blog that can be seen on the site consists of various articles about clients and their stories.

feeds.title: Natasha Rombough Blog
feeds.description: Natasha Rombough loves to document all the big moments, and it's tough watching couples try to decide while parts of the day mean the most to them! That's why all wedding collections include eight hours of coverage so that the highlights of your day -from the final touches on your hair to his grin on the dance floor -are documented for you to enjoy for years to come.

feeds.title: Stephanie Beach Photography Blog » Weddings
feeds.description: Stephanie and Dave are an award-winning, husband-and-wife duo specializing in Wedding and Family Milestone Photography. For them, photography is a passion that is so much more than just pretty pictures.

feeds.title: Ashley Notley Photography Blog
feeds.description: This was the wedding of dreams. Meredith and Jordan planned the most beautiful wedding at their family's private estate in Arnprior, just 45mins outside of Ottawa on the Ottawa River. The Grove House Estate has been in the family for years and was the perfect backdrop for this intimate backyard wedding. Meredith's uncle, who is

feeds.title: Anita Peeples Photography
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Anita, I've been working professionally as a photographer for over 10 years. What started out as a second shooting job for a friend has turned into a full-time wedding photography business. It's a lot of hard work, but I wouldn't change it for the world! My blog features some of my favourite weddings and engagement shoots over the years.

feeds.title: Sea and Silk Events Blog
feeds.description: Sea and Silk started in 2017 specializes in planning and designing luxury weddings for the free-spirited, modern bride in Ottawa and beyond. Visit their blog to find out about the wedding planning process with Sea & Silk Events, and to find out why it's important to hire a wedding planner for your Ottawa beach boho wedding.

feeds.title: Topaz & Lace Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the blog of Topaz & Lace Wedding and Boudoir Studios. We are an Ottawa Wedding, Boudoir, and Lifestyle Photographer, and Blogger. They service Ottawa and surrounding areas, including Kingston, Toronto, and Montreal, and we travel across the globe for destination weddings.

feeds.title: Nicole Amanda Photography Blog
feeds.description: Nicole and Max are a wedding photography team. They hope you grab some tea and enjoy viewing their latest work, browsing resources for photographers, and brides, and getting a little peek into our life! Blog of all past weddings by Ottawa wedding photographer. Read the blog to see the contemporary, bright & warm she brings to capture your nostalgic wedding.

feeds.title: SCOTT H WILSON Blog
feeds.description: Scott is a wedding and portrait photographer with a love of simple, romantic imagery and beautiful scenery. He combines journalism and fine art styles to make authentic photographs that perfectly reflect his clients. His blogs serve as a journal for visuals of his work where he has captured beautiful couples and created memories for them.

feeds.title: Rosielle + Co. Blog
feeds.description: Photography is so much more than thoughtful posing and expensive gear. Your wedding photography is a collaboration; a dance between us. From collecting inspiration, designing photoshoots, and picking locations right until the actual shoot day, we will work together to create a genuine experience that brings authenticity to every image we make. Browse wedding photography and videography on the blog.

feeds.title: Laura Fenny Photography Blog
feeds.description: Laura Fenny is a documentary wedding & elopement photographer for adventurous couples. Her mission is to create tangible memories for you & your love to look back on for years to come. Prepare to reminisce on the big as well as the little moments that make up the most important day of your life. Explore the stories about weddings, elopements, engagements, and recent love stories on Laura Fenny's blogs.

feeds.title: Joey Rudd Photography Blog
feeds.description: Joey Rudd Photography is an award winning and internationally acclaimed, husband and wife wedding photography team located in Ottawa. The wedding blog is his journal where he write about weddings, engagements, and everything else that I have been up to lately.

feeds.title: Pop-Up Wedding Ottawa Blog
feeds.description: Pop-Up Wedding Ottawa started when Denisa began to hear a lot of her friends ask for pop-up weddings and elopements. Not wanting a boring courthouse wedding, they were asking for unique venues and experiences that reflected their personalities. Recognizing there was a massive void in the wedding industry, Pop-Up Wedding Ottawa was born. Keep up to date with the latest news about weddings and many more.

feeds.title: Stryking Photography Blog
feeds.description: We are a team of two sisters that share the same passion for capturing the beauty of life's irreplaceable moments. We love what we do! Whether it's a wedding, family, or newborn session, photography is a profession that allows us to capture endless moments of true love.

feeds.title: Agatha Rowland Blog
feeds.description: The things that inspire me the most in the world are moments that can't easily be captured in a photograph. I find the art of capturing the energy of a wedding day very natural to me. I'm not in it for the simply pretty. I'm in it for the mix of nerves and excitement, the unexpected hiccups, the schedules that go awry, and the couples who throw their plans to the wind.

feeds.title: Mary Calotes » Wedding
feeds.description: Mary is a wedding photographer based in Ottawa Ontario, but travel worldwide. Her photography approach is intentional, honest, and editorial. An organic approach to capturing fleeting moments. This blog lives to inspire your wedding photos and provide you with planning tips.

feeds.title: Joel & Justyna Blog
feeds.description: Joel and Justyna are weddings, fashion, and editorial photographers documenting celebrations and projects around the world. we blend classic film work and with a modern documentary approach - focusing on joy, feeling, sentimentality with the most light-handed touch.

feeds.title: Amy Pinder Photography Blog » Weddings
feeds.description: Amy Pinder is not just someone who will take your photo. To her, wedding photography is about more than just images; she wants you to look back at your photos and remember how much fun you had taking them! After all, you'll be spending more time with your photographer on your wedding day than almost anyone else - and that time is precious!! Her wedding blog can be your guide for the wedding, stories, and many more.

feeds.title: Lauren McCormick Photography Blog
feeds.description: Lauren McCormick Photography blogs is a wedding blog full of love stories that will outlive both you and your grandchildren! Some highlights from celebrations all over the place!
